name: Easy Cauliflower-Egg Noodle Casserole with Cottage Cheese & Chives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat a large (9 x 13-inch) baking dish with cooking spray.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, then add pasta and cauliflower; stir for a few seconds and cook until both are just tender, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp salt
12 oz egg noodles, wide
1 (10 oz) bag cauliflower florets

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces. Place half in a large bowl along with cottage cheese, sour cream, and spices, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg chives
2 cups cottage cheese
1 ½ cups sour cream
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and cauliflower are done, drain in a colander, then add to the bowl with the cottage cheese mixture. Stir to combine the ingredients, then transfer to the baking dish and spread out in an even layer. Cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Place casserole in the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and continue to bake until casserole is bubbly and heated through, 20 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls, sprinkle with reserved chives, and enjoy!
